title: Neuromodulation via Modest Mouse, Circa 1997
subtitle: Modest Mouse played The knitting factory, and I was there.
text: The Frontier Psychiatrist is a health themed newsletter, but it's also a thing that I write, and sometimes I write things that are not didactic, express. You might learn something anyway. I try to keep weekends a little bit different than weekdays, and I write most days, but not every single day is something published, but behind-the-scenes, I'm writin…
